element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Deep soil area at least 10% of site area (7% where existing trees are retained) (Table 3.3a)
text: Deep soil areas are provided in accordance with Table 3.3a. Deep soil areas are to be co-located with existing trees for retention and/or adjoining trees, or alternatively provided in a location that is conducive to tree growth and suitable for communal open space.
notes: Table 3.3a 'Minimum deep soil area' 10% of site area, 7% if existing tree(s) retained on site. The 10%/7% cell is merged across all three site-area rows (confirmed p31), so it applies to every site area. 'Existing tree(s) retained' read as site.significant_tree_retained. The co-location sentence is A3.3.4-r1 (judgment). Regional: 10% deep soil competes with basement parking on 1,000 m2 lots.

verified.note: p31 Table 3.3a: the '10% OR 7% if existing tree(s) retained on site (% site area)' cell has no row rules and spans all three site-area rows.
